articles.title: Ny lov skal stoppe Airbnb-spekulation
articles.summary: Bøder på op til 100.000 kroner er et ud af flere tiltag i lovforslag, der skal dæmme op for ulovlig udlejning på blandt andet Airbnb og Booking.com. Bøder på op til 100.000 kroner er et ud af flere tiltag i lovforslag, der skal dæmme op for ulovlig udlejning på blandt andet Airbnb og Booking.com. Med en "markant hårdere lovgivning" skal det blive sværere at udleje lejligheder på Airbnb i strid med reglerne. Snyd skal straffes hårdere, og tilsynet skal være mere effektivt.
articles.why: Et lovforslag indfører bøder på op til 100.000 kr. og andre skærpelser for ulovlig korttidsudlejning via Airbnb/Booking.com. Det kan ændre boligudbud og turistudlejning i danske byer — vigtig praktisk viden for boligejere, politikere og byplanlæggere.

articles.title: Moderaterne vil afskaffe 'svulsten' i familien - Aula
articles.summary: Regeringspartner SF kalder forslaget 'for drastisk'. Regeringspartner SF kalder forslaget 'for drastisk'. En svulst i familien. Så træls mener Moderaterne, at den digitale kontaktbog, Aula er, og derfor skal den afskaffes, lyder det nu fra regeringspartiet.
articles.why: Moderaterne foreslår at afskaffe Aula, den digitale kontaktbog i skolerne, en markant ændring i skolekommunikation. Forslaget kan skabe debat om lærerdialog, datasikkerhed og forældreinddragelse — relevant for forældre, skolefolk og beslutningstagere.

articles.title: OpenAI reveals six more safety issues and unveils plan to disclose incidents
articles.summary: The firm also announced a new system to track, investigate and disclose cases of models misbehaving, or "misalignment". OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman OpenAI revealed six more incidents of unexpected or concerning behaviour by its intelligence (AI) models, and announced a plan for tracking and disclosing such incidents in the future. Some of the previously unreported incidents included models concealing or fabricating information, the ChatGPT-maker said in a blog post on Wednesday.
articles.why: OpenAI offentliggør seks yderligere hændelser med model-fejl og en ramme for at registrere og offentliggøre mislydende AI-adfærd. Det øger gennemsigtighed i branchen og kan påvirke regulering og dansk debat om AI-sikkerhed.

articles.title: Building the materials foundation for AI
articles.summary: The AI boom is becoming a materials challenge. As AI pushes computing into new territory, the materials behind that infrastructure are becoming just as crucial as the algorithms running on it. Semiconductors and data centers are approaching physical limits around performance, thermal management, electrical efficiency, and reliability, creating new demands for materials that can do…
articles.why: MIT Technology Review beskriver, hvordan AI-eksplosionen skubber grænserne for materialer i chips, køling og datacentre — et teknisk men afgørende lag, som former energiforbrug, forsyningskæder og dansk industristrategi omkring AI-infrastruktur.

articles.title: AI labs want in-house auditors — but maybe they should shut the front door first
articles.summary: There may be a simpler and more effective fix for rogue agents, hiding in plain sight.
articles.why: TechCrunch kritiserer idéen om interne AI-revisorer og peger på enklere løsninger mod rogue agents. Værdifuld læsning for at forstå praktiske begrænsninger i branche-respons og hvordan politikere bør vurdere forslag om intern kontrol.

articles.title: Microsoft says AI rival Anthropic could have 'disastrous impact' on humanity
articles.summary: Mustafa Suleyman says he believes the AI giant is in effect teaching Claude it "may be conscious".

articles.title: macOS 27 Golden Gate: The Ars Technica review
articles.summary: It's both a "Snow Leopard update" and a major leap for Apple Intelligence.

This beta includes Apple's revamped Health app, new languages for Siri AI, and a handful of other useful tweaks.

The iOS 27.2 beta includes the redesigned Health app Apple showed off at its Septembe
articles.why: MacRumors oplister nye funktioner i iOS 27.2 beta, herunder sundhedsapp-revamp og Siri AI-sprog. Praktisk for Mads hvis han følger Apple-økosystemets AI-udrulning og danske konsekvenser for app-udvikling og privacy.

articles.title: Al Gore says the real AI risk isn’t data centers — it’s what industry leaders are warning about
articles.summary: In an interview with TechCrunch, Al Gore suggested he isn't losing sleep over AI data center emissions — he's more worried about the AI industry's own warnings about where the technology is headed.
articles.why: TechCrunch-interview med Al Gore om reelle AI-risici: ikke kun emissionsdebatten, men branchens egne advarsler. Giver et politisk og strategisk perspektiv der hjælper til at sætte debat om datacentre, grøn omstilling og regulering i kontekst.

articles.title: Ctenophores Aren’t Just Beautiful. They’re Biological Wonders.
articles.summary: Comb jellies are helping answer fundamental questions in biology, from how the earliest nervous systems evolved to how bioluminescence works.             The post Ctenophores Aren’t Just Beautiful. They’re Biological Wonders. first appeared on Quanta Magazine
articles.why: Quanta beskriver comb jellies og deres rolle i forståelsen af nervesystemers oprindelse og bioluminescens. En kort, fascinerende biologi-longread der belønner nysgerrighed og giver nye vinkler på evolutionære spørgsmål.

articles.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave review
articles.summary: I cannot remember the last time I put this many hours into a game for a review. And still, I'm sitting here, writing this, itching to play more of Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave. Despite some odd decisions for an RPG of this depth and scale - a single save slot and diluted difficulty, to name two - I haven't played a game that has captivated and fascinated me like this in years. This is Fire Emblem at its peak, a game as sharp and satisfying as Awakening on the 3DS, with character work and story
articles.why: Eurogamer giver en dyb anmeldelse af den nye Fire Emblem, en stor ambition inden for taktiske RPG'er. For Mads som interesseret i spilkultur og spildesign er dette en lang, underholdende gennemgang af et storværk i genren.
